sentences.text:
Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No or directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  21.07. CRLR No.490 of 2023  2023 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Proposed Revision has been filed against the order dated 25.05.2023, passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge, F.T.S.C. Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar in Sessions Trial No.50 of 2023, by which, learned Judge has directed to frame charges against the revisionist - accused for the offence under Section 376(2) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Heard Mr. R.S. Kundu, learned counsel with Mr. M.L. Yadav, Avnish Sharma and Mr. Tajhar Qayyum, learned counsel for the revisionist and Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, learned AGA assisted by Ms. Shivali Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. Mr. R.S. Kundu, Advocate, has prayed for interim relief.
4. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that this is a fresh case and this is a case of digital rape.
Therefore, she has sought two weeks' time to file objection(s) to the proposed revision.
5. In the facts and circumstances of this case, it would be appropriate to grant proper opportunity to the State also before passing any order on the Stay Application.
At the request of learned counsel for the revisionist, list on 18.08.2023 in place of 04.08.2023.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 21.07.2023 Pant/
CRLR/490/2023 on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67508499/
